description: Fetch a reviewed public page and return every JSON-LD structured-data block it declares, parsed. No script is executed. A block that is malformed is reported as a named warning rather than being silently dropped, so a caller can tell an empty page from a broken one. Pay 5000 atomic USDC on Base via exact x402. MCP does not pay; it provides a challenge handoff.

url.description: HTTPS URL on a reviewed public origin. Permitted origins: https://docs.python.org, https://developer.mozilla.org, https://en.wikipedia.org, https://www.cisa.gov, https://www.sec.gov, https://home.treasury.gov, https://books.toscrape.com. robots.txt is honoured and redirects are refused.

name: page_json_ld
title: Page JSON-LD
